Package swiss.trustbroker.config.dto

Class LdapPoolConfig

java.lang.Object
swiss.trustbroker.config.dto.LdapPoolConfig
public class LdapPoolConfig extends Object
Connection pooling configuration for a named LDAP endpoint.
Without pooling every LDAP operation opens a new connection (TCP + bind) to the directory server, which adds latency and load. When pooling is enabled the underlying JNDI contexts are pooled and reused (backed by Spring LDAP PooledContextSource / commons-pool2).
Since:
1.16.0
